appearance_facts.fact: The NH region is located in the upper-right portion of the map and is colored light yellow.
The FL region is located in the lower-right portion of the map and is colored dark maroon.
The DE region is located on the mid-right coast and is colored light yellow.

appearance_facts.location: Comparison of NH, FL, and DE
appearance_facts.fact: The FL region is colored significantly darker than the NH and DE regions, which share a similar light yellow color.
The vertical legend on the right shows a gradient from light yellow at the top (labeled 'High') to dark maroon at the bottom (labeled 'Low').
The dark maroon color of FL corresponds to the bottom of the scale (near 0), while the light yellow of NH and DE corresponds to the top of the scale (near 100).
